---
name: Idea — a feature, a widget or a dashboard improvement
about: Suggest something IniqDash could do better or a widget it should have
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like to do?** (the goal, not the solution — e.g. "see at a glance which windows are open")

**Is it about** a new widget / an existing widget / the editor / the demo dashboard / themes / Widget Studio / something else

**How do you do it today?** (in IniqDash, in Home Assistant, or not at all)

**A picture says a lot:** a sketch or a screenshot of what you have in mind (your own, please — no copied designs)

> Home Assistant stays the brain: IniqDash shows and controls, it does not run automations.
